messages:
cara: Quick preflight — Wed 9am webinar (Inference at Scale). Final checklist: registration page live, Zoom RTMP fallback, recording + SRT, HubSpot UTM mapping, confirmation CTA. Who's owning each?

mike: Reg page is live on staging. Will push to prod after final CTA copy. URL preview: https://redwood.com/events/inference-scale-preview

jess: CTA suggestion for confirmation email: 'Add to calendar + Join live' and 'Watch recording' fallback. Shortened copy fits mobile.

tim: Zoom config done: cloud recording ON, SRT captions enabled, RTMP fallback set. Co-hosts: @jess @cara. RTMP creds in 1Password (Marketing/Webinars/RTMP).

jess: Please paste the 1P link here so producers can grab creds during greenroom.

tim: 1P: https://1password.com/teams/XXXX/item/webinar-rtmp (restricted access)

cara: HubSpot: form -> list 'webinars_2026'. Need hidden fields for utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_medium. @mike can you confirm mapping to HS properties?

mike: Hidden fields added on the form. Mapping done: utm_source->utm_source__c, utm_campaign->utm_campaign__c. Also set dedupe by email.

ops-bot: Reminder: Recording retention policy = 90 days. Post-event clip owners must be assigned within 48h.

jess: I'll own clips from slides + 60s social highlight. @mike you own registrant follow-up & lead routing?

mike: Yep. I'll wire HubSpot workflows: day0 send recording + slides, day3 send highlights + benchmark link. Also set lead scoring: webinar_view=+20, attended_live=+50.

cara: Follow-up email drafts in this doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abcd. Day0 = thank you + recording + CTA to benchmarks; Day3 = highlights + case study CTA.

jess: We need captions on the highlight clip. Sam from creative can confirm SRT handling. @sam can you confirm availability?

sam: I can do editing + captions. Need raw cloud recording access and SRT file. Please request via #eng-ops or tag me here post-event.

cara: One small ask — confirmation page CTA should include calendar add link with UTM params. mike, can you add ?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=inference_launch on the calendar link?

mike: Will add to CTA and to the landing page. Also implemented hidden field for gclid fallback.

jess: Quick snippet for the confirmation email header we agreed on: 

```
Subject: Thanks for registering — Inference at Scale (Wed)
Preheader: Recording sent after the event + slides
CTA: Add to calendar + Join live (primary), Watch recording (fallback)
```

cara: Live on-call rota: primary = @tim, fallback = @mike. Channel = #release-war-room. Tim can you confirm availability window?

tim: Standby 08:30-10:30 PDT on the day. I'll monitor Zoom, RTMP, and recordings.

mike: I'll be on backup from 09:00-11:00 PDT. I'll also monitor HubSpot workflows firing.

jess: Post-event checklist: 1) verify cloud recording integrity, 2) export transcript -> SRT, 3) assign clip owners, 4) push highlight to socials, 5) update benchmarks doc with event notes.

cara: I'll drop the final runbook + asset links here in 30m. Everyone please add any missing pieces now. :rocket:

ops-bot: Note: If RTMP fails, auto-fallback to Zoom cloud only — confirm RTMP producer knows to start backup stream manually if needed.

jess: Noted. Producers: @sam @tim @mike — be ready for manual RTMP start if we see errors.

cara: Thanks team — will post the final checklist and the tracking spreadsheet in this thread in a bit.
